items.title: The checklist we send with every proof
items.description: Eleven questions about data, code and consent. Authors answer them before the proof goes out, and the answers publish alongside the paper.

items.title: Why we stopped charging submission fees
items.description: Waivers already covered 41 per cent of submissions by 2024, so the desk dropped the fee outright and funded the gap from institutional seats.

items.title: Nine thousand papers, one search index
items.description: The Lodestar archive now spans 9,800 papers back to 2016. Here is how ten years of metadata were cleaned before any of it became searchable.
